fields.description: Raw participant id as reported by Meta (GET .../participants or the group_participants_update webhook) -- used verbatim, never normalized, since it identifies the participant within THIS group's API responses, not a conversation key of ours.

fields.description: Normalized (see takion_whatsapp.utils.normalize_phone_number) -- same dedup key 1:1 conversations use, so a group member who is already a Contact resolves onto the SAME Contact.

fields.label: Contact
